name: TeamStarWolf - Cyber Operations as Statecraft: The Hacker and the State Cases
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK v20.0 mapping of the state operations of 2006 to 2018 examined in case-studies/HACKER_AND_THE_STATE_CASES.md: OPM, APT1, Belgacom and Regin, Sony Pictures, Shamoon, the 2016 US election, Bangladesh Bank, WannaCry and the 2017 French campaign. Revoked T1070.001 is shown under its v20.0 successor T1685.005 per data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each technique is shown under all its tactics. Scores: 100 a government, court or vendor primary describes the behavior; 60 ATT&CK records it for the group or software but not for the dated event; 40 Reported only (journalism); 30 an Inferred mapping.
